text:
reena: Hey team — user reported confusion on /v1/generate docs. OpenAPI shows `input: "..."` while our JS and curl examples use `messages: [...]`. People migrating to chat models tried the `input` shape and hit validation errors. Can we standardize the examples?

sam: Yep, this has been creeping in. Runtime accepts both currently for compatibility, but our new chat-first models expect `messages`. Docs should lead with chat-style `messages` and include a tiny "legacy" note showing how to convert `input` -> `messages`.

kai: I'll take it. Plan: update API reference OpenAPI examples, inline SDK snippets (JS/py), and the quick curl example. Show recommended chat example first, then a one-line migration mapping. Example I will add to docs and examples repo:
```js
// recommended (chat-first)
await client.generate({ model: 'redwood-chat-1', messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize this doc' }] })

// legacy mapping
// { input: 'Summarize this doc' } -> { messages: [{ role: 'user', content: 'Summarize this doc' }] }
```
Also will update examples/node/generate.js and add a snippet-runner test asserting the runner accepts the new example.

ben: One more: the openapi response schema currently lists `choices` as an object in one spot. Linter flagged it — real responses use an array. We should update schema to `choices: [ { index: number, text?: string, delta?: string } ]` and include both non-streaming and streaming samples. Suggested non-streaming sample:
```json
{
  "id": "gen-abc",
  "choices": [ { "index": 0, "text": "Hello world" } ]
}
```
And a short note that streaming uses `choices[].delta` partial fragments while final chunk may populate `text`.

reena: Good catch. Please make the OpenAPI change and add the two response examples (streaming vs non-streaming). Ensure auto-generated SDK snippets pick up the OpenAPI examples so everything stays consistent.

kai: Draft PR up: https://github.com/redwood-inference/docs/pull/4410 — updates OpenAPI examples, sdk snippets, curl/python samples, and response schema. docs-bot: please run the build.

docs-bot: CI: docs build passed for PR #4410 ✅ preview: https://deploy-preview-4410--docs.redwood.ai/api-reference/generate

reena: Thanks! After merge I'll add a short note to the migration guide and a line in release notes about preferring `messages` for chat endpoints. Quick turnaround appreciated. :tada:
